perks.description: On a scoring play, a double adds 5 points.
perks.name: Double Trouble

perks.description: On a scoring play, a bone containing a blank adds 5 points.
perks.name: Zero Hero

perks.description: A scoring play made immediately after drawing adds 5 points.
perks.name: Lucky Pocket

perks.description: On a scoring play, a bone with 3 total pips or fewer adds 5 points.
perks.name: Low Rider

perks.description: On a scoring play, a bone with an odd pip total adds 5 points.
perks.name: Odd Job

perks.description: On a scoring play, a bone with an even pip total adds 5 points.
perks.name: Even Flow

perks.description: Your first scoring play of each round adds 5 points.
perks.name: First Blood

perks.description: Your remaining hand awards Rival 5 fewer points.
perks.name: Soft Landing

perks.description: A scoring play with an open-end total of exactly 5 adds another 5 points.
perks.name: Five Alive

perks.description: After losing a hand, your first scoring play next hand adds 5 points per stack.
perks.name: Round Insurance

perks.description: A scoring play that is your second or later consecutive play without visiting the boneyard adds 5 points.
perks.name: Hot Streak

perks.description: A scoring play made while you are behind adds 5 points.
perks.name: Comeback Kid

perks.description: Every time you go to the boneyard, one fixed face-down bone is revealed.
perks.name: Boneyard Lantern

perks.description: Once per round, draw two bones and keep the one with fewer pips.
perks.name: Light Fingers

perks.description: Whenever a malus lowers a scoring play, restore up to 5 points per stack.
perks.name: Pip Shield

perks.description: A scoring play on a vertical branch adds 5 points.
perks.name: Branch Bank

perks.description: Once per round, choose one of your bones and one face-down boneyard bone to swap.
perks.name: Bone Trader

perks.description: Once per round, replace a drawn bone worth at least 10 pips.
perks.name: Salvager

perks.description: Once per hand, reveal one hidden bone of your choice to reveal a random hidden rival bone. Both racks need at least three bones; revealed bones stay public while held.
perks.name: Open Book

perks.description: Once per hand, after an ordinary unplayable draw, return that bone face-up to its original boneyard position and end your turn. No replacement draw.
perks.name: Catch and Release

perks.description: Once per hand per stack, drag one pip across a bone's divider. Values stay within 0–6. The shifted bone becomes public and must be played this turn.
perks.name: Pip Shift

perks.description: Once per round, choose one of your bones and one face-down rival bone to swap blindly.
perks.name: Table Thief

perks.description: Once per round, arm a one-pip-away placement, preview its +1 or -1 change, and spend the charge only when played.
perks.name: Loaded End

perks.description: Once per round, arm one blank as a wildcard, preview its wild placement, and spend the charge only when played.
perks.name: Counterfeit Pip

perks.description: Once per draft per stack, upgrade the lower-rarity perk offer by one rarity tier.
perks.name: Fresh Cut

perks.description: A scoring play with an open-end total of at least 25 adds 20 points.
perks.name: Jackpot Ends

perks.description: On a scoring play, each distinct double you have played this round adds 2 points.
perks.name: Collector

perks.description: A scoring play with the 6-6 bone adds 30 points.
perks.name: Royal Train

perks.description: Each consecutive scoring play adds 5 more points than the previous scoring play.
perks.name: Domino Effect

perks.description: Your remaining hand can award Rival no more than 10 points.
perks.name: Bone Fortress

perks.description: Going domino doubles the opposing hand award.
perks.name: Clean Finish

perks.description: A scoring play with a double doubles the entire play.
perks.name: Golden Double

perks.description: Your blanks may match any open end.
perks.name: Wild Blank

perks.description: Once per round, choose a bone and change each value to its double-six complement.
perks.name: Pip Alchemy

perks.description: Once per hand, drag any number of pips across a bone's divider. Values stay within 0–6. The shuffled bone becomes public and must be played this turn.
perks.name: Pip Shuffle

perks.description: With one bone left, draw one extra face-down candidate per stack, reveal them, and choose what to keep.
perks.name: Dead Man's Draw

perks.description: On a scoring play, repeat your previous perk bonus.
perks.name: Echo Chamber

perks.description: Every third consecutive play made without drawing adds 15 points if it is a scoring play.
perks.name: Runaway Train

perks.description: Each non-scoring play banks a charge. Your next scoring play with an open-end total of 5 gains 5 points per charge.
perks.name: The Long Charge

perks.description: Rival's playable bones glow while remaining face-down.
perks.name: The Tell

perks.description: Your remaining pips can never score for Rival.
perks.name: Untouchable Hand

perks.description: Once per round, explicitly arm one otherwise-illegal play on any open end; spend the charge only when played.
perks.name: Master Key

perks.description: Reveal Rival's rack and choose both bones to swap. After use, wait through the next hand before using it again.
perks.name: Turncoat

perks.description: Once per round, arm it before you play. If that play scores, immediately play again.
perks.name: Time Loop

perks.description: When you trail by at least 30 points, your scoring plays are doubled.
perks.name: The Equalizer

perks.description: Once per hand per stack, play on any double's short side after one long side is filled. This opens its short sides for Four Winds holders.
perks.name: Four Winds

perks.description: On a scoring play, all point bonuses from perks are doubled.
perks.name: Midas Touch

perks.description: Every boneyard visit draws one extra face-down candidate per stack; reveal them and choose what to keep.
perks.name: Sovereign Draw

perks.description: Play locations reveal whether they expand or restrict Rival's legal options.
perks.name: Table Whisperer

perks.description: When Rival holds one bone, the safest legal play location is marked.
perks.name: Final Warning

perks.description: Rival gains 5 extra points from your remaining hand.
perks.name: Heavy Hand

perks.description: Every forced draw takes one additional bone.
perks.name: Greedy Draw

perks.description: A scoring double loses 5 points.
perks.name: Cracked Doubles

perks.description: Every visit to the boneyard costs you 2 points.
perks.name: Leaky Pocket

perks.description: Your highest-pip bone is anchored whenever another play exists.
perks.name: Bone Anchor

perks.description: An open-end total of exactly 5 scores nothing.
perks.name: Five Jinx

perks.description: Each perk bonus loses 1 point.
perks.name: Perk Tax

perks.description: The award from your remaining hand increases by 25 percent.
perks.name: Exposed Hand

perks.description: After scoring, you must draw on your next turn whenever possible.
perks.name: Stumble

rivalLevels.description: Easygoing company. Rival plays loose and leaves openings.
rivalLevels.name: Casual

rivalLevels.description: A sharper opponent. Rival plays with intent and punishes loose bones.
rivalLevels.name: Strategic

rivalLevels.description: The toughest seat at the table. Rival gives nothing away.
rivalLevels.name: Analytical

rivalStyles.description: Chases immediate points and keeps the scoring initiative.
rivalStyles.name: Score Hound

rivalStyles.description: Keeps bones open and preserves several routes through the rack.
rivalStyles.name: Table Controller

rivalStyles.description: Uses public draw and pass clues to squeeze the opponent's playable ends.
rivalStyles.name: Lock Artist

rivalStyles.description: Leaves stingy board counts and denies easy scoring replies.
rivalStyles.name: Counterpuncher

rivalStyles.description: Builds a connected route to an empty rack and the next hammer.
rivalStyles.name: Domino Racer

rivalStyles.description: Unloads heavy and awkward bones before they can become a hand penalty.
rivalStyles.name: Pip Shedder

rivalStyles.description: Drafts a scoring engine and favors plays that keep its perk triggers firing.
rivalStyles.name: Combo Crafter

skills.description: Reveal the current total of every exposed end during play.
skills.name: End Count

skills.description: Highlight every bone in your hand that can be played.
skills.name: Reader's Eye

skills.description: Make valid gray drop boxes glow when you select a bone.
skills.name: Landing Lights

skills.description: Scoring play locations flare pink before you commit.
skills.name: Fiver Sense

skills.description: Show projected open-end totals before you commit a play.
skills.name: Pip Forecast

skills.description: Increase the relative odds of uncommon or better perks by 12% per rank.
skills.name: Loaded Luck

skills.description: Further increase rare and epic perk odds by 15% per rank.
skills.name: Gilded Draw

skills.description: Further increase unlocked legendary perk odds by 25% per rank.
skills.name: Golden Thread

skills.description: Gain one free perk-card reroll in every draft per rank.
skills.name: Cut Again

skills.description: Take every offered perk and the Malus instead of choosing one card.
skills.name: No Half Measures

skills.description: Gain a 10% chance per rank to begin a run with a bonus common perk.
skills.name: House Favor

skills.description: Count how many unplayed bones outside your rack contain each pip, including public bones Rival still holds.
skills.name: Bone Memory

skills.description: Hover plays for follow-up counts. Rank 1 marks the best location. Rank 2 labels its count. Rank 3 also marks your best hand bone blue; scoring breaks ties.
skills.name: Branch Reader

skills.description: Each consecutive hand loss boosts uncommon-or-better draft weight by 25% per rank, up to three losses.
skills.name: Lucky Recovery

skills.description: New perks have a 10% chance per rank to echo as a second copy for the next hand.
skills.name: Perk Echo

skills.description: Automatically block the first triggered malus. Rank 1 works once per match; ranks 2 and 3 recharge after four and two hands.
skills.name: Malus Ward

skills.description: Reserve one perk offer for your next eligible draft, then take another perk offer now. Gain one use per match per rank.
skills.name: Fortune Mortgage

skills.description: A scoring play that fills the fourth side of a spinner gains 10 points per rank.
skills.name: Coffin Corner

supplies.description: Skip one required boneyard draw and yield the turn. Usable only when you have no legal play.
supplies.name: Table Pass

supplies.description: Earn 25% more XP throughout your next match.
supplies.name: Quick Study 1

supplies.description: Earn 25% more XP throughout your next three matches.
supplies.name: Quick Study 2

supplies.description: Earn 25% more XP throughout your next five matches.
supplies.name: Quick Study 3

supplies.description: Earn 50% more Bone Bucks throughout your next match.
supplies.name: Golden Ledger I

supplies.description: Earn 50% more Bone Bucks throughout your next three matches.
supplies.name: Golden Ledger II

supplies.description: Earn 50% more Bone Bucks throughout your next five matches.
supplies.name: Golden Ledger III

supplies.description: Change every blank half on one bone to a value from one to six. On 0-0, both halves change. The Epic pips determine placement and scoring.
supplies.name: Blank Check

supplies.description: For one trip to the boneyard, one fixed face-down bone is revealed.
supplies.name: Boneyard Lantern

supplies.description: After an unplayable draw, inspect a second fixed bone and choose which one to keep.
supplies.name: Rail Pass

supplies.description: Reduce one open end by one for the next scoring calculation. The board itself does not change.
supplies.name: Pip Eraser

supplies.description: If you win this hand and pass the hammer, your compensation draft has improved rarity odds.
supplies.name: Hammer Wax

supplies.description: Wager one eligible supply before a hand. Win to receive two copies; lose and it is gone.
supplies.name: Dealer's Dare
